scientific_integrity: The exact kernel and norm follow from a self-contained Walsh and heat-kernel derivation. The unbounded-dimensional claim is analytic; finite rational checks are reproducibility checks only. The novelty claim excludes general product-graph Green spectral formulas already known.
scientific_limitations: An O(1) remainder is proved, not a convergent constant term.
The graph Laplacian is unnormalized; switching to degree normalization multiplies the inverse norm by d.
Historical priority remains provisional, including an inaccessible older random-walk paper.
Independent mathematical and bibliographic validation have not been performed.
title: Sharp three-logarithm endpoint loss for the Boolean-cube Poisson Green operator
